Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: Public repository of data on scheduled power outages in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

Public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and automatically generating PNG images of scheduled and emergency power outage schedule charts in Ukraine.

The project retrieves data from publicly available websites of power suppliers and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered in a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abridged):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored "as is", without structural normalization.
- `fact` — actual and emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

GeFengJue/hotspot-crawler-app.body:
# Hotspot Focus Data Crawling System

This is a complete system for crawling and displaying hot news, today's hotspots, community hot posts, financial calendar and other content.

## Features

- 🔥 **Hot News**: Real-time crawling of trending news
- 📈 **Today's Hotspots**: Displays popular topics of the day
- 💬 **Community Hot Posts**: Popular discussion posts in the community
- 📅 **Financial Calendar**: Calendar of important financial events
- 🌐 **RESTful API**: Provides a complete data interface
- 📱 **Responsive Frontend**: Interface adapted to various devices

## Quick Start

### 1. Install dependencies
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 2. Start the API server
```bash
python api_server.py
```

### 3. Start the static file server
```bash
python static_server.py
```

### 4. Access the frontend
Open in your browser: http://localhost:8081/index.html

## API Endpoints

### Get hot news
```
GET /api/hot_news
Parameters: limit (optional, default 50)
```

### Get today's hotspots
```
GET /api/today_hotspot
Parameters: limit (optional, default 20)
```

### Get community hot posts
```
GET /api/community_posts
Parameters: limit (optional, default 50)
```

### Get financial calendar
```
GET /api/financial_calendar
Parameters: limit (optional, default 50), date (optional, date filter)
```

### Get statistics
```
GET /api/statistics
```

## GitHub Actions Automatic Deployment

The system is configured with GitHub Actions to automatically run 5 crawling tasks daily:
- Beijing time 9:00
- Beijing time 12:00
- Beijing time 15:00
- Beijing time 18:00
- Beijing time 21:00

## Project Structure

```
├── api_server.py          # Flask API server
├── database_manager.py    # Database management
├── fix_crawler.py         # Data crawling fix tool
├── hotspot_data.db        # SQLite database
├── index.html             # Frontend page
├── static_server.py       # Static file server
├── .github/workflows/     # GitHub Actions configuration
│   └── hotspot-crawler.yml
└──…

# ROS/ROS2 Examples

This repository contains ROS/ROS2 examples for environment setup, tutorials, and people and vehicles.

## Environment Setup

Run [`serve.bat`](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/ros2/blob/master/serve.bat) (which runs `mkdocs serve`; any changes must also be verified by running this script to check the modified content on [the web page](http://127.0.0.1:8000/)). It will open a browser showing the homepage. For details, see [serve.bat](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/.github/blob/master/serve.bat). For documentation writing conventions, see the homepage of the [doc](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/doc) repository.

## Notes

* Before submitting a Pull Request, check the following:
    * You **must** use **`mkdocs serve --livereload`** to check that the web page shows the desired changes before submitting
    * The Pull Request title and commit messages must not be arbitrary; they need to explain why the change was made, not just what was changed
    * Check that the content under 'File changed' on the Pull Request page is the intended change
    * Check whether the Pull Request page shows red warnings (conflicts); if so, merge the repository's latest changes before creating the Pull Request
    * Use screenshots, not photos
    * Personal information is not needed, since it is recorded in the git log commit history
    * Every Pull Request must ensure the entire module can be run directly through the main script; provide a demo of the running result in the commit message (animated GIFs can be made with [ScreenToGif](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif)), and provide instructions for the runtime environment and steps in the README.md document
    * When using large models, declare it at the end and take full responsibility for the submitted content
    * Markdown documents go in the [docs](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/ros2/tree/master/docs) directory and the corresponding module folders; source code (.py, .cpp, etc.) goes in the [src](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/ros2/tree/master/src) directory and the corresponding module folders
    * File names must be entirely in English, with no spaces, Chinese characters, or pinyin; separate multiple words with underscores `_`
    * Each module's files go in a folder named after the module; it must support launch startup, with the entry point starting with main., e.g., main.py, main.cpp, main.bat, main.sh, etc.

YufJi/tiny.body:
# Tiny - Mini-program Engine

A mini-program engine based on [glass-easel](https://github.com/wechat-miniprogram/glass-easel): dual-side tree (service logic tree + host render tree), versioned bridge protocol, standalone compiler, and a browser debugger.

**Online demo**: [Tiny debugger online](https://yufji.github.io/tiny/devtool/index.html), no local build required. You can directly select the sample apps under `tests/apps` to run.

## Architecture

The kernel is strictly pure: `packages/runtime` does not depend on any host. The browser, iOS, and test hosts share the same kernel, and all environment capabilities are injected from the boundary.

```text
  Source (WXML / WXSS / JS / TS)
        │
        ▼
  tools/cli ──► manifest + service.js + templates.js + styles
        │
        ├───────────────────┬───────────────────┐
        ▼                   ▼                   ▼
  browser host          iOS host            test host
  iframe / port    JSCore / WKWebView  in-memory transport
        └───────────────────┼───────────────────┘
                            │ Injected: transport / canvas / renderer / API / resources
  ==========================+==================================================
                            ▼
  packages/runtime (pure kernel, no host globals)
  ├─ service thread: App / Page / Component + glass-easel logic tree
  ├─ tree protocol: component flow / virtual node patch / tree event
  └─ render thread: TreeRenderer contract, rendering implementation injected by host
                            │ depends only on
                            ▼
  @tiny/manifest / @tiny/bridge /…
```

# Tianji · DU <sub>v0.5.2</sub>

Two schools read the same question, you vote blind, and only then is it revealed who answered. Dated claims go into a prediction ledger that you fill in yourself.

[Chinese](https://github.com/badhope/DU/blob/HEAD/README.zh-CN.md) · [Roadmap](https://github.com/badhope/DU/blob/HEAD/ROADMAP.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/badhope/DU/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)

| Ask | Blind match | After voting |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |

## Install

```bash
# CLI
npm ci && npm run build:all
node build/cli.mjs ask "我要不要换工作" --domain career

# Desktop (Windows, no Node needed)
build/install.cmd
tianji serve                 # http://127.0.0.1:7317

# MCP (Claude / VS Code / Cursor)
{ "mcpServers": { "tianji": { "command": "tianji", "args": ["mcp"] } } }
```

## What it does

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Ask once | Write down your question. You may add your birth date and time (required for 子平 and 紫微斗数 charts) |
| Blind match | Two anonymous answers. Before voting, you cannot see names, schools, or chart layouts |
| Reveal | After voting, you see who answered and the citation sources |
| Backfill | A week later, come back and say whether the claim was accurate |

Core methods: 子平八字, 梅花易数, 紫微斗数. All calculations run locally.

MIT. Public-domain sources for the classical texts are listed in `public/corpus/manifest.json`.

## What is this

A Windows-first Dynamic Island. It integrates WeChat, QQ, and email notifications, clipboard history, quick translation, a Codex status light, media controls, daily to-dos, and more.

fly-island runs as a lightweight, borderless, always-on-top floating island. It expands when needed and returns to a compact state when done, reducing how often you switch windows just to get a piece of information.

## Why I built it

During daily work or study, I often need to write a to-do list in one app. To block out noise, I open a music app and set the volume to just the right level. Work and study also often rely on translation websites, and I repeatedly copy and paste code. At the same time, it's hard to avoid receiving messages from different group chats and friends.

Switching back and forth between these interfaces not only lowers efficiency but also easily distracts. So I started to wonder: could these high-frequency features be integrated into one place that is lightweight enough?

I thought of the iPhone's Dynamic Island, which concentrates message notifications, timers, media controls, and other information onto one small island, shortening the path to getting information. So FocuSD was born. The name stands for **Focu Study and DeepWork**, focused study and deep work. The project was developed with the lighter Tauri architecture, but it has since been renamed fly-island.

## Features

The core problem fly-island aims to solve is the frequent window switching during work and study.

fly-island puts high-frequency operations scattered across different windows into a single collapsible, expandable floating island:

- **Image and text clipboard history**: Records copied text and images. Search content or notes, favorite frequently used items, add notes, delete records, and copy back to the clipboard with one click. The history count, image records, and global summon shortcut are configurable.
- **QQ, WeChat, and QQ Mail**: Switch between QQ, WeChat, and Mail in one row of brand navigation; tool buttons share a single top row. QQ notifications and mail each keep the latest 20 items. Mail supports opening the body within the island and returning to the list.
- **Quick translation**: Open a standalone translation window with a global shortcut. It automatically detects the Chinese/English direction or lets you set it manually. It can fill the source text from the clipboard and copy the translation.
- **AI status light**: Shows task running, completed, or needs-attention states via Codex and Claude Code lifecycle hooks. Hooks can be installed or repaired in settings.
- **To-dos, daily notes, and archive**: Manage today's tasks, mark them complete, and set the current task. Record daily notes and browse the history archive. Optionally auto-carry over unfinished tasks, and save tasks and notes as Markdown.
- **Music and system audio**: Switch to the previous track, play/pause, and go to the next track via the Windows media session, and show audio activity with a dynamic waveform.
- **Appearance and startup settings**: Switch between classic or liquid-glass appearance, and system or pixel fonts. Adjust size, opacity, color, and top offset. Save up to 6 custom style presets, control title display, and launch at startup.

kino516/HyperPower.body:
# Pengpai Charge Control HyperPower

A **KernelSU / APatch module** that closed-loop controls charging speed based on battery temperature, and can set a charging limit.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Display name | **Pengpai Charge Control HyperPower** (since 2026-10-20; formerly 温控充 ThermoCharge) |
| Module id | `a_hyperpower` (the `a_` prefix **sorts it near the top** of the KernelSU module list); data directory **`/data/adb/hyperpower`** (a fresh project that does not inherit old `thermo_charge` configuration); when upgrading from the old id, **uninstall the old module first** |
| Form | Root-resident native daemon + WebUI (the APP is maintained in a separate repository) |
| Engine | Rust (stable), single binary |
| Supported baseline | **Android 12 (API 31) and above**, **arm64-v8a only** |
| Current version | **1.0.5** (adjusted temperature gating per the user's final decision: **when battery temperature < hardware protection temperature, charging is fully suppressed regardless of charge pump temperature; only handed over to the official mechanism when reaching or exceeding the hardware protection temperature**. The hardware protection temperature uses the value from the detection profile, which is 48℃ on this device. 1.0.4: temperature gating to avoid high-temperature negotiation; 1.0.3: current-pressure writeback; 1.0.2: profile suppression + brand cleanup; 1.0.1: profile readback fix; 1.0.0: first official release) |
| Implementation status | Backend / WebUI / detection / multi-mode / charging history **all complete** and verified on real devices |

> ## 🔴 **Must restart the phone** after installing or updating
>
> The module contains `sepolicy.rule`, which grants SELinux access to the charging control nodes (on some models, writes are rejected even with `uid=0` due to an SELinux type mismatch).
>
> KernelSU **only applies this file during the `post-fs-data` stage at boot**; module updates do not hot-load it.
>
> Symptoms if you do not restart: node probing, the UI, and the detection profile all look normal, but **writes fail** (reporting `Permission denied`), appearing as 'the setting was applied but had no effect'.

---

## Design baseline (locked)

| ID | Decision | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| B1 | **Module / APP separation** | The APP is maintained in a separate repository; the module zip **contains no APK**; enforced by a reverse assertion at packaging |
| B2 | **Supported baseline Android 12+** | Install script gate `API ≥ 31`; `module.yaml`'s `androidMinApi` is kept in sync with it |
| B3 | **APP and module share the same backend** | Same `hyperpower` binary, same protocol, same JSON contract; the APP requests root itself and connects through the root channel |…

lfandrh/indextts2-studio.body:
> **Author / Maintainer: Bilibili [@十一君Jun](https://space.bilibili.com/470166715)**
>
> Video demos and update news are all on Bilibili. You can also leave questions and feedback there.

A locally adapted version of the official [IndexTTS2](https://github.com/index-tts/index-tts) model. It replaces the official gradio WebUI with a local workbench built on **FastAPI + vanilla JavaScript**: the service starts instantly, idle time doesn't occupy VRAM, generation shows five-step real-time progress, results include waveform playback and a “crop / volume / speed” editing panel, and segment-level SRT / VTT subtitles can be exported. Presets and terminology pronunciations can be saved and reused.

**Measured on RTX 3060 Ti 8GB**: for the same test text, total generation time is reduced to about 1/9 of upstream (normalized to 12.77 seconds of audio of the same length: 151 s → about 17 s, RTF 11.87 → 1.31). For a Chinese long-form text of about 500 characters, with 25 diffusion steps / CFG 0.7 / fp16 all enabled:

| Configuration | Generation time | Audio duration | RTF | Peak VRAM |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Segment-by-segment generation (default) | 93.5 s | 105.6 s | **0.89** | 6.03 GB |
| Two segments per batch | 67.7 s | 105.8 s | **0.64** | 7.80 GB |

Peak VRAM is the whole-card usage reported by `nvidia-smi`, including about 0.7 GB for the system and desktop. Model generation itself uses about 5.3 GB (segment-by-segment) / 7.1 GB (two segments per batch).

**An RTF below 1 means faster than real time**: for 105 seconds of audio, the default mode finishes generating in about 93 seconds, and two-segments-per-batch finishes in about 68 seconds. After model loading, about 5.6 GB of VRAM stays resident (with all three FP16 options enabled). With batch processing enabled, the peak is about 7.8 GB, so an 8 GB GPU can produce output reliably. For the three rounds of detailed results, see [Section 8](#8-500-字长文本实测rtf).

It also includes an **AI Agent Skill** (`skills/indextts2-tts/`). After installing it into DSH / WorkBuddy / Claude Code, you can simply say “read this script aloud using Hu Tao's voice”. The agent checks the service status itself, selects a voice, synthesizes the audio, and returns the audio path. Long texts can also be automatically split into segments and run in batches. See [AI Agent Skill](#ai-agent-skill让-ai-直接调用这套服务) for details.

txhtxh11/txhlock.body:
# txhlock · Answer-to-Unlock Lock Screen (Xiaomi TV Edition) v1.9.18

A gate for the kids' TV: answer questions first, then watch TV. It locks automatically once the set viewing time is reached, and the remote unlocks it after several consecutive correct answers. Parents can unlock directly with a PIN, switch question banks, adjust the time limit, and choose the textbook edition.

> **Three highlights of v3.0**
> 1. **Overlay lock screen**: The lock screen is now a system overlay that sits above all apps. When the child presses the remote's Home key, the desktop **does not appear at all** (not "flashes and then gets taken back").
> 2. **Back to the 1.9.1 interface**: Deep navy blue and royal blue #1E5AF0, large fonts, large buttons; all settings fit on one page, with no digging through layers of pop-ups.
> 3. **Textbook-synced question banks**: New banks for the People's Education Press, Beijing Normal University, Jiangsu Education Press, FLTRP, and Yilin Press editions. Questions are drawn by edition and grade, with 2000+ built-in questions.

---

## 1. Feature Overview

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Timed lock | After a single continuous viewing session reaches the set duration, the screen automatically locks full screen |
| Daily limit | Set a daily cumulative viewing cap; the TV locks as soon as it is reached |
| Answer to unlock | Answer N questions correctly in a row (1 to 10, default 3) to unlock; a wrong answer resets the count |
| Overlay lock | The lock is a system overlay, so even if the Home key is used to switch to the desktop, it is covered directly and the desktop never appears |
| Textbook sync | People's Education Press / Beijing Normal University / Jiangsu / FLTRP / Yilin / General, with questions prioritized by "edition + grade" |
| Built-in bank | **2000+ questions**: 958 general questions plus 1113 textbook-synced questions (mainly Chinese, math, and English). Ready to use after install and works offline |
| 13 question types | Mental arithmetic, math, Chinese, English, physics, chemistry, biology, history, geography, politics, character recognition, classical poetry, custom |
| Grade-based questions | Only questions for that grade and below. If an edition has too few questions, lower grades are merged in automatically, so nothing exceeds the grade level |
| Custom bank | Put a txt file in `/sdcard/Download/txhlock/` on the TV to import it. Duplicates with the built-in bank are removed automatically |
| SMB sync | Automatically pulls questions from Windows shares. On Android 4.3 the component may not be available, and the interface will show a notice |
| Parent PIN | Built-in numeric keypad. Default `1234`, changeable to 4 to 8 digits |
| Anti-reboot bypass | With "Answer before boot" enabled, the lock is applied once on every real boot |
| Remote control | One page scrolls up and down. The selected item has a blue background, white text, and a white border. Answers are laid out 4 per row, so only left and right movement is needed |

**System requirements**: Android 4.3 (API 18) and above. Verified on real hardware: Xiaomi TV 2 (MiTV2-49 / Android 4.3 / 1080p).

---

> With a computer: double-click `安装器\一键安装.bat`, or send one sentence to Doubao (Agent mode).
> Without a computer: copy `txhlock_v1.9.18.apk` to a USB drive and install it on the TV.

xiaopeng66/ai-welfare-daily.body:
# AI 福利日报

Aggregates **AI relay station / public-welfare station / quota welfare** posts from six Chinese forums. Automatically fetches, deduplicates, and tags them every hour, and generates a pure static page published to GitHub Pages. No backend, no database, no manual work.

**Live site:** https://xiaopeng66.github.io/ai-welfare-daily/

## Data Sources

| Site | Scope |
|------|----------|
| linux.sb | Welfare Broadcast, Promotion Requests, Giveaways, Key Distribution, Homepage |
| baipiao.org | Latest across the site |
| nodeloc.com | Latest across the site, giveaway welfare |
| vibex.iflow.cn | Supply Station |
| linux.do | Welfare Deals |
| nextbuf.com | Homepage (all sections mixed; only relative times are available, see below) |

> The listing and topic pages of nextbuf.com only show relative times ("17 days ago", "31 minutes ago") with no absolute publish time. Its `created_at` is an estimate back-calculated from the scrape time (rounded to the current hour / the current day / the 1st of the current month). For this reason, it is not marked as "publish time verified", and the time precision for this batch of posts is limited to these buckets.

## Site Features

- **Two sections**: Last 24 hours / Older than 24 hours, plus a view grouped by date.
- **Two filter dimensions**: by source, and by category (tags are automatically assigned from title keywords).
- **Two sort orders**: by relevance score, and by time.
- **Duplicate folding**: Duplicate posts with identical titles under the same source, as well as multiple posts whose body text is judged to be the same welfare offer (e.g., the same event reposted by many people), show only the latest one. The ×N badge indicates the number of folded posts.
- **Real-time "Last 24 hours" calculation**: Determined by the reader's browser clock, not a flag frozen at scrape time.
- **Site-wide Beijing time**: When accessed across time zones, date groupings and card times remain consistent.
- **Relevance score**: A mechanical keyword-matching score based on titles. It does not represent a recommendation or endorsement.
- **Pure static single file**: No CDN, no framework, no external dependencies. It can be opened directly offline.

## Usage

Open https://xiaopeng66.github.io/ai-welfare-daily/ to use it. **No login, no API, and no configuration are required**; the page supports self-service filtering.

## Running Locally

```bash
python3 fetch.py -o data/topics.jsonl                            # Fetch (including offer detection at the body layer)
python3 fetch.py -o data/topics.jsonl --content-limit 0          # Fetch only, do not fetch body text
python3 fetch.py -o data/topics.jsonl --content-stealth-limit 0  # Do not fetch…
